translation:
|| Here begins the holy Lodhi Karaj ||12||

1. Maya, like the goddess Shikotar, has seized the soul; it has been loaded with unclean spells and poisons and the like — take refuge in Hari, the Parbrahm king. ||1||
2. To avert the womb there is no other means — take refuge in Hari, the Parbrahm king. ||2||
3. In the Name of Parbrahm complete the great circle of worship; by remembrance call upon Narsinh and Vir. ||3||
4. By the Name of Parbrahm accomplish the great mantra; bind the mind steady, together with the senses. ||4||
5. Where there is no earth, no water, no sky, no wind, no fire — there too you alone are, my Lord, the one Parbrahm. ||5||
6. Within prakriti (nature), moving and unmoving, you set the jiva (individual soul); and to torment it in hell you gave the power into Yama's hand. ||6||
7. Through the soul you cause karma to be done; and to undergo that karma you cause a body to be taken. ||7||
8. In the power of birth and death the soul has been ruined; stung and filled with pain [unclear], it did not cry out with your Name. ||8||
9. When you, Lord, lay upon the leaf of the banyan tree — tell me, where was the soul then? ||9||
10. Your worthless devotee makes his petition with folded hands: meet me now, and release me from this anguish. ||10||

|| Thus Shri Lodhi Karaj is complete ||12||
